title: Dominic and the Detention
author: Vesper Nakamura
blurb: Wendell Whitlock, a debate champion who can't win the argument at home, counts days until graduation like a sentence being served. But when the teacher pairs nemesis with nemesis for a semester-long project, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must win the championship that doesn't matter — and the one that does before prom.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
